name: Bottom tab bar
summary: Up to five icon and label links fixed to the bottom of the screen, for the main sections of a phone app.
description: Use it on phones for the few top-level sections people switch between often. It stays clear of the home indicator through safe-area insets, which need viewport-fit=cover in the viewport meta. Give the page matching bottom padding, and hide it on wider screens with .v-hide-desktop.

classes.name: v-bottombar
classes.description: The bar, on a <nav> of links. Fixed to the bottom edge, one equal column per link.

states.description: On the current section: accent text and a tinted pill behind the icon.

a11y: Give the <nav> an aria-label such as App sections.
Keep a visible text label under every icon; icons alone are hard to tell apart.
A badge is read as part of the link name, so add .v-sr-only context where a bare number is unclear.
Each link is at least 3.25rem tall, a comfortable touch target.

examples.title: Bottom tab bar
examples.description: The bar is fixed to the bottom of the frame, as it would be on a phone screen.
